# Chikn Game Assets model context

This repository distributes classified Chikn, Roostr, and FarmLand visual content plus an Apache-2.0 npm runtime helper. Read README.md, LICENSE, INTEGRATION.md, and AGENTS.md first.

Ownership/licensing:
- official Chikn/Roostr/FarmLand visual artwork is protected Chikn content (`CHIKN-COMMUNITY-NONCOMMERCIAL`)
- this identifier records Chikn's existing community permission; Roost2D grants no independent licence or sublicense
- protected records require third-party ownership, hosting/community permission, no repository sublicense, and exact technical hashes
- rig definitions, transforms, animation timing, code, schemas, manifests, docs, and water_swim_ring_coq.png are project-authored Apache-2.0 material
- artwork displayed by a rig remains protected
- manifest excludedPaths are not Chikn property and never enter published artifacts; eggorithm.png is the regression example

Canonical source layout:
- sources/chikn-atlas and sources/roostr-atlas retain the source atlas pairs
- sources/traits-chikn and sources/traits-roostr contain the only individual character images, including Base/<skin> parts
- retired flat/rig copy trees must not be recreated; config/asset-aliases.json preserves old IDs without duplicate files

Artifact roles:
- @chikn-game-assets/runtime: code/types/IDs only, no images, caller supplies host
- runtime ZIP: manifest plus default/high atlases and public community-use notices for games/CDNs
- sources ZIP: classified originals/metadata for editors and audits

Sources are in sources/. Generated outputs are runtime/, reports/, manifests/rights-manifest.json, and packages/runtime/catalog. Do not hand-edit generated output or casually refresh rights hashes.

Primary commands:
npm ci
npm run build
npm run check
npm run release:verify

Publish order is Roost2D next, Chikn runtime next, cross-repo verify, then stable latest. Never publish without an explicit release decision.
